binding_verification.method: Executed and inspected packet verify_candidates.py against supplied pinned implementation. binding_verification.source_commit_authentication_limit: This verifies supplied bytes against the commit-labelled packet bindings; this reviewer did not independently fetch remote Git commit/tree objects.

global_qualifications: All decisions are independent static whole-string judgments, not adoption of author confidence.
No source, candidate packet, repository, remote service or application was changed. Only this review output and a temporary output-generation script were written.
No native-human, device, layout, compiled resource, runtime, legal or whole-locale acceptance is asserted.
All original 118 terms remain untouched; the existing 110 are context, not newly accepted here.
No P1 expansion. Missing ui_no_resize_fits_decoder_memory, ui_image_assembly and other neighboring values retain current fallback and review state.
PR56 never-merge, PR159 freeze, PR113 held/retarget work, Help callback/archive identity and release pause are not changed.

entries.source: This assembly is estimated to exceed the current working-memory budget, even at the smallest output size. Reducing the assembly dimensions alone is not enough under the current limits. Close other documents or prepare a smaller source image before trying again. Your assembly is unchanged.

Med dei gjeldande grensene er det ikkje nok å berre redusera dimensjonane på biletmontasjen. Lukk andre dokument eller lag til eit mindre kjeldebilete før du prøver på nytt. Biletmontasjen er uendra.

entries.rationale: All six essential propositions are explicit: er estimert preserves estimated rather than absolute failure; meir arbeidsminne enn den gjeldande grensa tillèt preserves the current working-memory ceiling; sjølv med den minste utdatastorleiken covers the smallest output; ikkje nok å berre redusera dimensjonane preserves dimensions alone; Lukk andre dokument eller lag til eit mindre kjeldebilete preserves alternative remedies before retry; Biletmontasjen er uendra preserves the non-mutating outcome. Biletmontasje, gjeldande, tillèt and lag til are coherent Nynorsk. The English-shaped estimated construction is somewhat formal but comprehensible and not a semantic or grammatical blocker. AssemblyRenderer.suggested returns null after fits(1,1) fails; estimatedBytes combines resident/output/decoder work, so this is not a decoder-only impossibility warning.
qualifications: Accept only this P0 whole value. The absent P1 ui_no_resize_fits_decoder_memory is neither proposed nor accepted; all frozen warning history remains unchanged. Implementation must first support an explicitly single-key NN receipt without inferring paired coverage.
